page: OVHcloud b3-16 is a general-purpose virtual instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an AMD EPYC x86_64 processor clocked at 2.3 GHz, offering 4 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading (1 thread per core). It is configured with 16 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per core. For storage, the configuration includes 100 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and no GPU hardware is attached.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded processing capabilities alongside balanced multi-core execution. In synthetic testing, the instance reaches top-quartile performance in stress-ng single-core tests and Geekbench text processing tasks. Multi-threaded throughput aligns with middle-tier expectations, scoring 5,737 in Geekbench multi-core and 12,080.84 in stress-ng multi-core evaluations. In-memory processing remains consistent, reaching 10.26 million operations per second on Redis SET tests, while static web serving throughput registers in the lower quartile relative to peer hardware.

The allocation of fully dedicated physical cores ensures predictable compute performance without the risk of noisy neighbor contention across shared execution threads. However, vector throughput is bounded by the absence of AVX-512 support, and network throughput remains constrained to baseline gigabit speeds. OVHcloud b3-16 serves effectively as an infrastructure layer for web application hosting, continuous integration and build pipelines, backend API services, and relational database systems that benefit from fast local NVMe storage.
description: OVHcloud b3-16 is a general-purpose virtual machine designed for balanced compute and memory workloads. Driven by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor running at 2.3 GHz, the instance delivers 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core and 16 GB of RAM, adhering to a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It includes 100 GB of bundled NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps, with zero GPU hardware attached. Benchmark assessments demonstrate strong single-core CPU execution and solid text processing performance, complemented by typical mid-tier results in multi-core metrics and in-memory key-value processing via Redis. However, static web serving and large-scale model inference throughput show architectural constraints. Given its dedicated core architecture and fast local solid-state storage, OVHcloud b3-16 is appropriate for continuous integration workers, web servers, backend API hosting, and moderate database workloads.
